name: The World Ecademy
format: live small groups (maximum 20 learners per class), with recorded videos as backup
timings: Live classes Monday to Friday; start times stated for UAE (7:30 am) and Saudi Arabia (6:30 am) only
timings_note: India start times and session length are not stated.

curriculum.summary: Primary (Grades 1-5) follows the TWE Integrated curriculum, which the site says blends NCERT, NIOS, BOSSE and Pearson Edexcel standards. Primary learners follow NIOS or BOSSE levels A and B.

fees_note: India annual tuition for 2027-28: Rs 42,500 (Nursery) to Rs 67,500 (Grade 8); admission fee Rs 1,000. Grades 1-5 are not priced separately.
